Name: (CP) T's Greenhouse(10x10)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][quote][size=4]The respect source of the 10x10 idea is "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2143]10x10 Greenhouse[/url]﻿".[/size][/quote][/center]
We tried to make it easy to use without being overly spacious so as not to ruin the vanilla atmosphere.

[list]
[*]Tillable area to 10x10 to match iridium sprinklers.
[*]The outside of the greenhouse is slightly wider so that the greenhouse will not be too tight when fruit trees are planted.
[*]Removed some objects that would hinder movement after planting fruit trees.
[*]When exiting the greenhouse, the toolbar sometimes made it difficult to find the exit, so we widened the exit to two tiles wide.
[/list]
[size=3]You can remove the ornamentation and change the flooring in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] setting.[/size]
If you want to completely replace the flooring to your liking, please read the pop-up instructions on the setup screen carefully.
